tools.name: verify
tools.title: Verify Action
tools.description: Verify an action against policy bounds before executing it. Returns ALLOW (proceed), CONSTRAIN (proceed with modified values; emitted on the wire as the legacy value CLAMP - both refer to the same verdict, CONSTRAIN is the public name), or DENY (stop). Every verification is recorded in a hash-chained provenance ledger. Cost: $0.01 per call.

action_payload.description: Action parameters to verify against policy bounds

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent requesting verification

policy_context.description: Optional policy overrides such as max_values or forbidden_keys

template_id.description: Named policy template (e.g. 'robotics-arm', 'financial-transaction'). Merged with policy_context.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key for idempotent retries  -  same key returns cached result

tools.name: attest
tools.title: Attest Action
tools.description: Create a hash-chained provenance record for an action you've taken. Each attestation extends the append-only evidence chain. The hash can be independently verified by any third party. Cost: $0.02 per call.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the attesting agent

action_description.description: Human-readable description of the action taken

action_payload.description: Structured data describing the action (hashed into provenance)

context.description: Optional metadata such as environment, trigger, or session info

tools.name: bind
tools.title: Bind Intent to Command
tools.description: Declare an intent and cryptographically bind it to a command. Proves that the command was issued in service of the declared intent. Use verify-outcome after execution to close the loop. Cost: $0.02 per call.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent declaring intent

intent_description.description: Human-readable description of what the agent intends to do

command_payload.description: The command that will be executed to fulfill this intent

goal_state.description: Expected end state for outcome verification

intent_source.description: Origin of intent: AI_PLANNER, HUMAN_OPERATOR, or SYSTEM

parent_intent_id.description: ID of parent intent for hierarchical intent chains

tools.name: verify-outcome
tools.title: Verify Outcome
tools.description: Verify that an executed action achieved its declared intent. Closes the loop: intent -> command -> action -> outcome -> verification. Free (included with bind).

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent whose outcome is being verified

intent_id.description: ID of the original intent from governance_bind

binding_id.description: ID of the intent-command binding from governance_bind

actual_state.description: Observed end state after action execution, compared against goal_state

tolerance.description: Numeric tolerance for goal matching (0.1 = 10% deviation allowed)

tools.name: bundle
tools.title: Generate Compliance Bundle
tools.description: Generate a certifier-grade compliance evidence bundle. Contains hash-chained provenance, intent bindings, PQC attestations, and verification instructions. Independently verifiable without Kevros access. Cost: $0.05 per call.

agent_id.description: Agent whose provenance records to include in the bundle

max_records.description: Maximum number of provenance records to include

include_intent_chains.description: Include intent-command binding chains in the bundle

include_verification_instructions.description: Include step-by-step verification procedure for auditors

tools.name: health
tools.title: Health Check
tools.description: Check the governance gateway health status. Free.

verbose.description: Return additional details such as chain length and PQC signing status

tools.name: status
tools.title: Trust Status
tools.description: Check your current usage and quota: calls used, calls remaining, tier, rate limits, and billing status. Free.

include_chain_details.description: Include hash-chain integrity check and latest provenance epoch

tools.name: check-peer
tools.title: Check Peer Trust
tools.description: Check another agent's trust score and governance history. Returns trust score (0-100), chain length, attestation count, and tier. Free, no API key needed.

agent_id.description: ID of the peer agent to look up

tools.name: verify-token
tools.title: Verify Release Token
tools.description: Verify a release token from another agent. Confirms the token is authentic, was issued by the Kevros gateway, and remains currently authorized after any halt or mode transition. Free, no API key needed.

release_token.description: Release token string received from governance_verify

token_preimage.description: Deprecated. The gateway now performs verification entirely server-side using the release_token alone; any value supplied here is ignored. Field retained for backward compatibility with v1 SDK callers and will be removed in a future release.
